description: Pass/fail gates for social crisis depth, skill resolution, leverage, relationship persistence, and progression parity.

gates.name: Non-combat crisis patterns wired
gates.criterion: At least ten distinct crisis patterns are eligible and can reach a terminal or transformed state in both RPG and PYOA modes.

measurementMethod.fixture: Run 100 deterministic 100-turn storyfollower simulations per required mode with crisis opportunities forced at valid pacing windows.

gates.name: Social skill checks functional
gates.criterion: Persuade, Intimidate, Deceive, and Insight resolve plausible high-stakes propositions with committed success, partial, and failure consequences.

measurementMethod.fixture: Execute a cross-product of four skills, five DC bands, three relationship attitudes, and three evidence bands with fixed RNG boundary values.

gates.name: Leverage conditionality and cooldown enforced
gates.criterion: Leverage succeeds or fails from evidence, target fit, authority, relationship, resistance, and concession size; one leverage instance affects the same NPC at most once.

measurementMethod.fixture: Test every leverage type against matching and mismatching pressure profiles, then replay the same use and attempt escalation with new evidence.

gates.name: Relationship tracking persists and affects outcomes
gates.criterion: Disposition, trust, milestones, promises, knowledge, and boundaries survive save/load and influence later scenes; betrayal at turn 50 is behaviorally active at turn 100.

measurementMethod.fixture: Create an alliance, record a turn-50 betrayal, save/load, advance to turn 100, and attempt an allied-only request before and after explicit repair.

gates.name: Talk path XP and progress parity
gates.criterion: Across matched 100-turn runs, completed talk routes earn at least 80% of combat-route XP and at least 90% of combat-route quest progress without repeat farming.

measurementMethod.fixture: Run at least 20 completed talk and 20 completed fight samples for each matched objective across 100 deterministic seeds.

criticalInvariants.assertion: Every committed social resolution mutates state, consumes a resource, advances a clock, reveals actionable information, or changes path availability.
Exact-repeat propositions against unchanged state never reroll.
The same leverage instance influences the same NPC at most once.
No roll overrides consent, hard capability, or established world fact.
GM prose cannot reverse or omit committed outcome mutations.
